nodes.label: outlines package
nodes.desc: Re-exports Generator, types, models, processors, Template and cache controls as the public API surface.

nodes.label: Generator factory
nodes.desc: Compiles an output type into a logits processor once, then binds it to a model for call, batch and stream.

nodes.label: Term DSL
nodes.desc: Term classes (Regex, CFG, JsonSchema) plus python_types_to_terms and to_regex that lower Python types into regexes.

nodes.label: Lark grammars
nodes.desc: Loads .lark grammar files; the native dict type maps to the JSON grammar.

nodes.label: backend registry
nodes.desc: Routes constraint work to outlines_core (JSON/regex), llguidance (CFG) or xgrammar and builds the logits processor.

nodes.label: OutlinesCoreBackend
nodes.desc: Turns a model tokenizer into an outlines-core Vocabulary, compiles Index from regex, and drives Guide bitmask biasing.

nodes.label: LLGuidanceBackend
nodes.desc: Microsoft llguidance-based processor; the default backend for context-free grammars.

nodes.label: OutlinesLogitsProcessor
nodes.desc: Base class standardizing input_ids/logits to 2D tensors and dispatching to a tensor adapter.

nodes.label: tensor adapters
nodes.desc: Registry mapping torch, numpy and mlx to concrete TensorAdapter implementations.

nodes.label: model zoo
nodes.desc: Exports all model wrappers and the SteerableModel / BlackBoxModel / AsyncBlackBoxModel protocol unions.

nodes.label: Transformers
nodes.desc: Steerable wrapper around HF PreTrainedModel: tokenizes, passes the logits processor into generate, decodes.

nodes.label: outlines-core wheel
nodes.desc: Pins outlines_core==0.2.14, the Rust-backed crate providing Vocabulary, Index, Guide and tensor kernels.
